title: Best PR Strategists for Hire (2026): Media and Reputation Plans
description: How to hire a PR strategist for media relations, launches or reputation planning: story angles, outreach, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: PR strategists help your business earn attention from media, podcasts, industry publications and communities. They find newsworthy angles, plan launches, prepare spokespeople and protect your reputation when issues arise. Good PR builds credibility that paid ads cannot buy. PR goes wrong when there is no real story, outreach is mass-mailed, or someone promises guaranteed coverage. This guide helps you hire a strategist who earns real attention.
